description.narrative: For 2025, the main goal for Cimmyt in the current project is “To improve resilience and create opportunities for diversified livelihood strategies of communities in Niassa Province, Mozambique”. For the achievement of this goal, CIMMYT will undertake the following acivities: 1)Support the legal registration, governance, business incubation, and market contracting of farmers organisations; 2) Train and equip agro-dealers in the use of ICT tools for marketing, advisory services, and market data management; 3) Organize district-level trade fairs and finance market linkage events to connect producers, aggregators, and buyers; 4) Contract and provide technical support to IIAM, TVETs, and seed companies for certified seed and QDS production; 5) Co-design nutrition messaging for households in collaboration with national agencies; and 6) Convene and strengthen district-level multi-stakeholder platforms for coordination, joint planning, and knowledge exchange. - This project aims to reach the Furthest Behind First, targeting mainly women and youth. It is expected that around 20,000 families are reached by the project during thos year, with new techniques and innovation. This is aligned with our Mission Strategy under the Outcome 6: Marginalised women and youth benefit from climate reisilient climate sustainable food systems, livelihoods and nutrition. These advances align with the Government of Mozambique’s National Plan for Investment of Agriculture Sector (Plano Nacional de Investimento do Sector Agrário-PNISA), which identifies seed system development, market integration, and nutrition improvement as key drivers of inclusive rural growth. The results produced by the project will make a substantive contribution to outcome 6 of our Mission Stratey, and will be a key source for case studies and lessons learned processes.
